entities.summary: Mathieu Rodrigues is a French professional tennis player. He competes mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour and ITF Futures, both in singles and doubles. He reached his highest ATP singles ranking No. 221 achieved on 24 October 2011 and his highest ATP doubles ranking, No. 549 achieved on 3 October 2011.
